policy.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com https://a.tile.opentopomap.org https://mt1.google.com https://server.arcgisonline.com https://tile.openstreetmap.fr https://tile.openstreetmap.org; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

rateLimits.scope: per client address, evaluated per worker process

note: No user authentication is implemented. Terminate TLS and add an authenticating reverse proxy before exposing this API to the internet.
